audit.title: HandiEdge / AI Sports Lab — Verified Repository Audit
audit.note: Supersedes the prior external audit (status BLOCKED/BLACK), which reported UNKNOWN for every item solely because it had no repository access. This audit was run against the working tree with commands executed and exit codes captured.

checks.label: Full file audit
checks.evidence: 217 tracked files; git ls-files enumerated per package.

checks.label: Git history audit
checks.evidence: 5 commits, linear history from initial commit to HEAD 6950ea3.

checks.label: Branch audit
checks.evidence: claude/step-9-ai-multi-agent-review-1lg1xi (tracks origin).

checks.label: TODO / placeholder scan
checks.evidence: 0 TODO/FIXME/placeholder/'not implemented' in artifacts/handiedge/src.

checks.label: Secrets scan
checks.evidence: 0 hardcoded keys/tokens; credentials only via process.env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, HANDIEDGE_API_KEY).

checks.label: Unit tests
checks.evidence: 53 tests pass: ai-review 21, pipeline 4, handiedge 15 (unit+e2e), python 13.

checks.label: End-to-end tests
checks.evidence: handiedge tests/e2e.test.ts runs train -> predict -> settle and asserts PASS-on-data-gap + reproducible content hashes.

checks.label: Python engine tests
checks.evidence: 13 passed.

checks.label: API startup
checks.evidence: GET /healthz -> {status:ok}; POST /predict -> full slate JSON.

checks.label: CLI daily run
checks.evidence: handiedge run --date 2026-07-25 prints the card: 1 PLAY / 2 PASS.

checks.label: Reproducibility controls
checks.evidence: Seeded (seed 42); identical inputs -> identical content hashes; run manifest records input+model hashes.

checks.label: Audit logging
checks.evidence: out/audit_<date>.jsonl written per stage with input/output hashes.

checks.label: Model training (real)
checks.evidence: Logistic model trained on recorded history fixture: AUC 0.586, logloss 0.6862 (1500 train / 500 valid).

checks.label: Lint
checks.evidence: Repo uses Prettier only; no ESLint config present. Typecheck (strict-ish) is the static-analysis gate.

checks.label: Docker build
checks.evidence: Dockerfile present and reviewed, but the Docker daemon is not running in this sandbox (no /var/run/docker.sock), so the image could not be built here.

checks.label: Docker Compose
checks.evidence: Single-service tool; no compose file. Dockerfile covers the service.

checks.label: Frontend startup
checks.evidence: HandiEdge is a CLI/API tool with no frontend. (artifacts/mockup-sandbox is an unrelated scaffold that typechecks.)

checks.label: DB migrations
checks.evidence: HandiEdge is filesystem/JSON based; no database. (lib/db exists but is unused by the tool.)

checks.label: Duplicate-code detection
checks.evidence: No jscpd run. Known intentional duplication: the transparent baseline formula exists in both Python (Phase-2 engine) and TypeScript (daily tool) as separate-language ports.

checks.label: Dead-code detection
checks.evidence: No dedicated tool; typecheck clean. lib/db and lib/api-* are scaffold packages not used by the daily tool.

priorExternalAudit.reason: No repository access — every item UNKNOWN.
